mapper.sql: c.id, c.content, c.embedding, d.source_type AS sourceType, d.ref_id AS refId, d.title AS title
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_knowledge_doc WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND ref_id = #{refId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_knowledge_doc (source_type, ref_id, title, status) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{refId}, #{title}, 'PENDING')
INSERT INTO t_knowledge_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, content, embedding) VALUES (#{docId}, 0, #{content}, #{embedding})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_knowledge_chunk c JOIN t_knowledge_doc d ON d.id = c.doc_id WHERE MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM t_knowledge_chunk c JOIN t_knowledge_doc d ON d.id = c.doc_id
